resources.string: Select which fields represent the Source Word and Translation of your flashcards.
We\'ve automatically identified your language patterns. HTML tags have been stripped and spacing normalized.
Anki decks may contain audio, images, or video. These media files will not be imported — only the text content of each field is kept.
Long sentences may be harder to study
If your Anki deck contains full sentences or paragraphs, they may be difficult to use as flashcards. Consider choosing shorter fields when possible.

Each Anki field is shown below. Assign one field as the Source Word (front of your card) and one as the Translation (back). All other fields will be ignored. Scroll down to preview how your cards will look.
